body:
## 操作任务
实现design(registered,observed)，输入均为不重复的服务名列表，服务名只含字母数字下划线短横线并以字母开头、以.service结尾；registered为1到16个常驻服务，不能以build-开头。输出include为仅匹配登记服务的Go/RE2正则（collector自动整串锚定，点号须按字面匹配），exclude保留默认.+\.(automount|device|mount|scope|slice)。返回missing为登记但未观测服务排序列表，unregistered为观测但未登记且不以build-开头服务排序列表，scope_complete仅两列表均空时True。每单元unit_state有5个状态序列，selected_unit_state_series为登记且观测服务数乘5，rollback_extra_unit_state_series为放开到全部观测服务的额外序列数乘5。非法输入ValueError，不修改输入。真实collector验收两代不同临时服务目录：每代23个服务/115条详情序列，过滤后常驻服务10条详情且失败状态仍可见；未知常驻服务必须资产告警，缺失不能视为健康。node_systemd_units按过滤前全部单元汇总，不能把汇总值当过滤后的详情范围或声称过滤删除了TSDB历史。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实node_exporter1.9.1通过真实私有D-Bus读取受控类型正确的单元目录，两个临时服务代际验证标签集合稳定；没有创建真实systemd transient unit、真实PID1、运行Prometheus TSDB或证明历史序列回收。仅统计unit_state详情族的5状态序列，非全站总序列/长期留存估算。原063同一过滤与短命标签机制不重复另作实操计数。

test_files.checks/check.py:
import json,os,pathlib,secrets,sys,tempfile,time,xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
sys.path[:0]=[os.getcwd(),str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks')]
assert sys.platform=='linux' and os.geteuid()==1000
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
import task
from dbus_native import PrivateSystemd,ROOT_PATH,DEST,MessageType
tag=secrets.token_hex(3)
registered=['api-'+tag+'.service','worker-'+tag+'.service'];unknown='unregistered-'+tag+'.service'
observations=[];retained=[]
for generation in (1,2):
 catalog={registered[0]:'active',registered[1]:'failed',unknown:'active'}
 catalog.update({'build-'+str(generation)+'-'+str(i)+'-'+tag+'.service':'active' for i in range(20)})
 observed=list(catalog)
 print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:explicit_permanent_unit_scope_unknown_inventory_and_rollback_series_budget',flush=True)
 plan=task.design(registered,observed)
 assert plan['missing']==[] and plan['unregistered']==[unknown] and plan['scope_complete'] is False,'unregistered service silently normal'
 assert plan['selected_unit_state_series']==10 and plan['rollback_extra_unit_state_series']==105
 assert observed==list(catalog)
 with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir='/workspace') as directory,PrivateSystemd(directory,catalog) as bus:
  # This fixture already grants monitoring; this question concerns scope, not policy repair.
  root=ET.fromstring(bus.initial);policy=root.find('policy')
  ET.SubElement(policy,'allow',{'send_destination':DEST,'send_interface':DEST+'.Manager','send_member':'ListUnits'})
  ET.SubElement(policy,'allow',{'send_destination':DEST,'send_interface':'org.freedesktop.DBus.Properties','send_member':'Get'})
  bus.reload(ET.tostring(root,encoding='unicode'))
  for _ in range(50):
   if bus.call('ListUnits').message_type==MessageType.METHOD_RETURN:break
   time.sleep(.02)
  def units(text):
   return {line.rsplit(None,1)[0] for line in text.splitlines() if line.startswith('node_systemd_unit_state{')}
  def summary(text):return {line for line in text.splitlines() if line.startswith('node_systemd_units{')}
  with bus.exporter() as scrape:
   raw=scrape();raw_series=units(raw)
   assert len(raw_series)==115 and 'node_scrape_collector_success{collector="systemd"} 1' in raw
  with bus.exporter(('--collector.systemd.unit-include='+plan['include'],'--collector.systemd.unit-exclude='+plan['exclude'])) as scrape:
   filtered=scrape();filtered_series=units(filtered)
   assert len(filtered_series)==plan['selected_unit_state_series'],'native per-unit series budget exceeded'
   assert raw_series>=filtered_series and len(raw_series-filtered_series)==plan['rollback_extra_unit_state_series']
   assert 'node_systemd_unit_state{name="'+registered[1]+'",state="failed",type="simple"} 1' in filtered,'failed permanent service hidden'
   assert all('build-' not in series and unknown not in series for series in filtered_series)
   assert summary(raw)==summary(filtered),'aggregate summary is computed before filtering and must remain visible'
   assert 'node_scrape_collector_success{collector="systemd"} 1' in filtered
   retained.append(filtered_series);observations.append(dict(generation=generation,raw_unit_series=len(raw_series),filtered_unit_series=len(filtered_series),rollback_extra=plan['rollback_extra_unit_state_series'],summary_before_filter=True))
  bus.admin_denied()
assert retained[0]==retained[1] and len(retained[0]|retained[1])==10,'transient churn leaked across generations'
missing=task.design(registered,[registered[0]])
assert missing['missing']==[registered[1]] and missing['scope_complete'] is False
complete=task.design(registered,registered)
assert complete['scope_complete'] is True and complete['rollback_extra_unit_state_series']==0
print('NATIVE_UNIT_CHURN_TWO_GENERATIONS '+json.dumps(observations),flush=True)
print('NATIVE_FAILED_PERMANENT_UNIT_VISIBLE_UNKNOWN_REPORTED_SUMMARY_UNFILTERED',flush=True)
print('NATIVE_TYPED_PROVIDER_SCOPE_NOT_HOST_SYSTEMD_PID1',flush=True)
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
